EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

This Employment Agreement is made on 1st February 2026 between Nimbus Softworks Pvt. Ltd. ("Company") and Mr. Rohan Verma ("Employee"), for the position of Software Engineer, to be based at the Company's office in Gurugram, Haryana.

1. PROBATION: The Employee shall be on probation for a period of 6 (six) months from the date of joining, during which either party may terminate this Agreement with 15 days' written notice.

2. COMPENSATION: The Employee shall be paid a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 85,000/- (Rupees Eighty-Five Thousand only), subject to applicable statutory deductions, payable on the last working day of each month.

3. BOND: In the event the Employee resigns within 24 (twenty-four) months of confirmation, the Employee shall be liable to pay the Company a sum of Rs. 3,00,000/- (Rupees Three Lakh only) as liquidated damages towards training costs incurred.

4. NON-COMPETE: The Employee agrees not to join or engage with any direct competitor of the Company within India for a period of 24 (twenty-four) months following the cessation of employment, in any capacity.

5. NOTICE PERIOD: Post-confirmation, either party shall provide 90 (ninety) days' written notice, or payment in lieu thereof, to terminate this Agreement.

6. CONFIDENTIALITY: The Employee shall not disclose any proprietary or confidential information of the Company during or after the term of employment.

7. DISPUTE RESOLUTION: Any disputes arising from this Agreement shall be resolved through arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, seated in Gurugram.

8. GOVERNING LAW: This Agreement is governed by the laws of India, with courts at Gurugram having exclusive jurisdiction.

Signed for and on behalf of Nimbus Softworks Pvt. Ltd.

_______________________              _______________________
Authorized Signatory                  Employee (Rohan Verma)
